value.rationale: A canonical pair of cospectral, equal-parameter conference graphs first differ in ordinary first-order rank five, while the first 4-e.c. Peisert order is sharply determined at 361 with an exact ten-witness margin. These motivate the precise finite-field tests and give a natural model-theoretic cutoff; the claim is not merely a known table recomputation.
